answers.core: This is a very small change, and there wouldn't be much of a reason to make a plugin specifically for it.
answers.workaround:
This can be worked around by not mapping `ui_cancel` to anything, which might not be a great solution if other things in the game rely on it.

Another solution is giving the line edit a script that handles the `ui_cancel` input and manually adds the letter that's being overriden to the position of the carret or its capital variant if shift is held. This is a horrible hardcoded solution, and if `ui_cancel` if mapped to more than one input, it might just make things more complicated.

title: Allow disabling exit behavior on the LineEdit node
